workflows.name: Task lifecycle
workflows.trigger: A task is created in a project
steps: Task created in the project's default (backlog) state
Prioritized into an unstarted/to-do state
Work begins, moved to a started state
Work finishes, moved to a completed state
Or the task is cancelled at any point before completion

provenance.notes: State names are verbatim from Plane's StateGroup enum (backlog/unstarted/started/completed/cancelled/triage); transition/event names are reasoned, not literal from source. Kanboard's simpler is_active open/closed status is a degenerate case of this same shape (backlog+unstarted+started collapse to 'open'), which is why this isn't scored medium: the multi-state grouping itself is only verified in one implementation.

workflows.name: Subtask completion rollup
steps: Contributor completes a subtask
Parent task shows updated sub-task completion count/ratio
Once all subtasks are completed, parent task may be flagged ready to complete (not auto-completed)

provenance.notes: Plane's Issue.parent self-FK (sub_issues_count is computed) and Kanboard's SubtaskModel (with its own status) both support this rollup pattern, though neither source was observed to auto-complete the parent.

workflows.name: Task dependency management
workflows.trigger: Two tasks need to be sequenced or linked
steps: Select the related task
Choose a relation type (blocks, relates to, duplicate, start/finish before)
The reverse relation is recorded automatically on the related task
Dependency is surfaced on the board/Gantt view as a blocker or link

provenance.notes: Verbatim from Plane's IssueRelationChoices and its _RELATION_PAIRS/_REVERSE_MAPPING (e.g. blocked_by <-> blocking is auto-derived, not a stored second row); single source.

workflows.name: Commenting and mentions
workflows.trigger: A contributor wants to discuss or notify someone about a task
steps: Write a comment on the task
Optionally @-mention a teammate
Mentioned user receives a notification
Other participants can react to the comment

workflows.name: Cycle (sprint) planning
workflows.trigger: A new iteration is about to start
steps: Create a cycle with start/end dates
Add tasks from the backlog into the cycle
Cycle becomes active once its start date arrives
Track burndown as tasks complete during the cycle
Cycle closes at its end date; incomplete tasks roll to the next cycle or backlog

provenance.notes: Reasoned from Plane's Cycle.start_date/end_date and CycleIssue join table; Plane computes cycle status from these dates rather than storing an explicit status enum, so the steps here are reasoned, not verbatim. Single source.

workflows.name: Time tracking
workflows.trigger: A contributor starts working on a task
steps: Start a timer on the task (or subtask)
Stop the timer when work pauses or finishes
Duration is recorded as a time entry
Totals roll up for reporting

provenance.notes: Kanboard's SubtaskTimeTrackingModel start/stop timer pattern; single source, modeled per-subtask rather than per top-level task in Kanboard specifically.
